description:
Follow-up promised by the fz-mue.29 page (/Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-mue.29.html), which the user approved 2026-11-20 with the recommended answer to every decision (relayed by Elixir Parity). In Elixir typespecs a map type is closed: it admits only the listed pairs (a bare key means a required pair). Start with a census of what closing map types breaks in fz today (fixtures, specs, std), then propose. Owner: Elixir Parity.

Re-test on develop de4ef6a3b (Elixir Parity, 2026-11-24; user-approved update): kept by the user as a type-precision ticket. Elixir 1.19.4 compiles a @spec returning %{a: integer()} on a function returning %{a: 1, b: 2} with no warning, and fz behaves the same, so the gain is fz's type precision, not observable parity. Evidence: Elixir Parity's fresh/report.md.
title: Map types are closed, as in Elixir typespecs
